messages.content:
You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
buddha_tooth | Buddha Tooth Relic Temple | 0 | 45 | 07:00-17:00 | -
cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -
adventure_cove | Adventure Cove Waterpark | 40 | 180 | 10:00-17:00 | -
artscience | ArtScience Museum | 30 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
supertree_grove | Supertree Grove | 0 | 45 | 05:00-24:00 | -
orchid_garden | National Orchid Garden | 15 | 60 | 08:30-19:00 | -

Travel times in minutes (row -> column):
buddha_tooth: cable_car 18, adventure_cove 20, artscience 15, supertree_grove 16, orchid_garden 22
cable_car: buddha_tooth 18, adventure_cove 14, artscience 22, supertree_grove 23, orchid_garden 21
adventure_cove: buddha_tooth 20, cable_car 14, artscience 24, supertree_grove 24, orchid_garden 25
artscience: buddha_tooth 15, cable_car 22, adventure_cove 24, supertree_grove 12, orchid_garden 24
supertree_grove: buddha_tooth 16, cable_car 23, adventure_cove 24, artscience 12, orchid_garden 26
orchid_garden: buddha_tooth 22, cable_car 21, adventure_cove 25, artscience 24, supertree_grove 26

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

My day out runs from 11:00 until 17:05. My budget is S$65. I want to visit Buddha Tooth Relic Temple and Singapore Cable Car. If there's time, I'd also like Adventure Cove Waterpark, ArtScience Museum, Supertree Grove and National Orchid Garden. I want to do Supertree Grove before ArtScience Museum. I want to do Singapore Cable Car before Buddha Tooth Relic Temple. I want to do Buddha Tooth Relic Temple before Singapore Cable Car. I want to be at Singapore Cable Car no earlier than 11:00 and done there by 11:35. I'd like to spend 120 minutes at ArtScience Museum. I'd like to spend 75 minutes at Supertree Grove.
